questions.question: Which PPE is most important for protecting eyes from welding arc radiation?
options: Welding helmet with correct shade lens
questions.explanation: Arc welding produces intense ultraviolet and infrared radiation. A proper welding helmet with the correct lens shade protects the eyes and face.
